mapper.select: SELECT v.id, b.name AS brand, v.name, v.trim_name, v.model_year, v.condition_code, v.class_code, v.fuel_code, v.seating_capacity, v.price, v.efficiency_value, v.efficiency_unit, v.image_url, v.source_name, v.source_url, v.is_example FROM vehicles v JOIN brands b ON b.id = v.brand_id ORDER BY v.price, v.id
